suite.title: SOC 2 Type II Readiness
suite.framework_version: 2017 Trust Services Criteria with revised points of focus (2022)
suite.purpose: Local readiness checks and evidence inventory for a future SOC 2 Type II examination.
suite.disclaimer: Results are readiness observations, not a SOC 2 report, audit opinion, attestation, certification, or substitute for examination by an appropriately licensed independent CPA firm. Management defines the system and controls; the service auditor determines scope, procedures, sampling, and conclusions.

applicability.rule: Run Common Criteria readiness checks for every target. Run additional-category checks only when management's intended SOC 2 scope includes that category. Final scope and criteria suitability are matters for management and the independent service auditor.

criteria_groups.title: Governance and control environment
criteria_groups.readiness_focus: Integrity, oversight, accountability, competence, and organizational structure.
criteria_groups.automation_boundary: The tool can inventory policies, approvals, role records, and dated evidence; it cannot judge governance effectiveness or auditor sufficiency.

criteria_groups.title: Information and communication
criteria_groups.readiness_focus: Quality and communication of internal and external control information.
criteria_groups.automation_boundary: Local checks can locate current policies, acknowledgements, and external commitments; understanding and effectiveness require interviews and audit procedures.

criteria_groups.title: Risk assessment
criteria_groups.readiness_focus: Objectives, risk identification and analysis, fraud risk, and significant change.
criteria_groups.automation_boundary: The tool can test completeness, dates, ownership, and traceability of a risk register; it cannot determine whether management's risk judgments are reasonable.

criteria_groups.title: Monitoring activities
criteria_groups.readiness_focus: Ongoing or separate evaluations and communication of deficiencies.
criteria_groups.automation_boundary: Local evidence timelines can show that reviews and remediation records exist; an auditor evaluates design and operating effectiveness.

criteria_groups.title: Control activities
criteria_groups.readiness_focus: Selected control activities, technology controls, and implementation through policies and procedures.
criteria_groups.automation_boundary: The tool can map stated controls to technical configurations and evidence, but cannot conclude the overall control system is effective.

criteria_groups.title: Logical and physical access controls
criteria_groups.readiness_focus: Access architecture, provisioning, removal, authorization, boundaries, transmission, and malicious software safeguards.
criteria_groups.automation_boundary: Repository and exported-configuration checks cover part of logical access. Physical safeguards, actual user behavior, and control operation require evidence and auditor testing.

criteria_groups.title: System operations and incident handling
criteria_groups.readiness_focus: Configuration, monitoring, anomaly evaluation, incident response, and recovery.
criteria_groups.automation_boundary: Local analyzers can inspect configuration and sampled logs and exercises. They cannot prove complete monitoring coverage or effective response throughout the examination period.

criteria_groups.title: Change management
criteria_groups.readiness_focus: Authorization, design, development, configuration, testing, approval, and implementation of changes.
criteria_groups.automation_boundary: Local repository history and exported tickets can identify exceptions; auditor-selected samples and contextual review remain necessary.

criteria_groups.title: Risk mitigation and vendors
criteria_groups.readiness_focus: Risk responses and risks arising from vendors and business partners.
criteria_groups.automation_boundary: The tool can reconcile vendor inventories, reviews, contracts, and risks; management and the auditor evaluate sufficiency.

criteria_groups.title: Availability
criteria_groups.readiness_focus: Capacity, environmental protections, backup, recovery, and continuity when availability is in scope.
criteria_groups.automation_boundary: Local capacity and restore tests provide point-in-time evidence only; commitments, historical operation, and auditor evaluation remain outside the tool.

criteria_groups.title: Processing integrity
criteria_groups.readiness_focus: Processing objectives and controls over inputs, processing, outputs, and stored information when processing integrity is in scope.
criteria_groups.automation_boundary: Local functional and reconciliation tests can sample stated processing behavior, but cannot establish operation for all transactions or the full period.

criteria_groups.title: Confidentiality
criteria_groups.readiness_focus: Identification, protection, retention, and disposal of confidential information when confidentiality is in scope.
criteria_groups.automation_boundary: Local scans can locate classification, encryption, retention, and disposal evidence but cannot establish complete enforcement across the organization.

criteria_groups.title: Privacy
criteria_groups.readiness_focus: Notice, choice and consent, collection, use and retention, access, disclosure, data quality, and privacy monitoring when privacy is in scope.
criteria_groups.automation_boundary: Local document and application checks can identify evidence and inconsistencies; legal conclusions, population completeness, and operating effectiveness require qualified human review and audit procedures.

test_scaffolds.title: Governance evidence inventory
test_scaffolds.limitations: Presence and freshness do not demonstrate that leadership, oversight, accountability, or competence operated effectively. Requires interviews, sampling, and service-auditor judgment.

test_scaffolds.title: Policy publication and acknowledgement coverage
test_scaffolds.applicability: when local policy, personnel, customer-commitment, and acknowledgement exports are available
test_scaffolds.limitations: Cannot determine whether recipients understood communications or whether all relevant external parties received them.

test_scaffolds.title: Risk register completeness and freshness
test_scaffolds.applicability: when a local risk register and control inventory are provided
test_scaffolds.limitations: Checks structure and traceability only. It cannot decide whether objectives are suitable or risks and responses are complete or reasonable.

test_scaffolds.title: Control monitoring and deficiency lifecycle
test_scaffolds.applicability: when monitoring results, exceptions, remediation records, policies, and control mappings are available
test_scaffolds.limitations: Does not determine whether controls are suitably designed or whether auditor samples support operating effectiveness.

test_scaffolds.title: Repository authentication and authorization configuration review
test_scaffolds.applicability: software targets with readable source and local deployment configuration
test_scaffolds.limitations: Static findings are indicators. They do not prove production configuration, identity-provider enforcement, correct business authorization, or operation throughout a period.

test_scaffolds.title: User access population reconciliation
test_scaffolds.applicability: when local exports of identities, roles, privileged accounts, personnel status, and access-review decisions are available
test_scaffolds.limitations: Export completeness and authenticity must be established. Physical access and source-system enforcement are outside this check.

test_scaffolds.title: Transport and stored-secret configuration review
test_scaffolds.applicability: locally runnable web/API targets and source repositories
test_scaffolds.limitations: A local environment may differ from production. Secret pattern matches require review; malware prevention and organization-wide transmission controls are not fully tested.

test_scaffolds.title: Security logging and alert evidence review
test_scaffolds.applicability: when application configuration and a bounded local log sample are available
test_scaffolds.limitations: Sampled logs do not establish complete telemetry, alert accuracy, continuous monitoring, or response effectiveness over the Type II period.

test_scaffolds.title: Incident response exercise evidence
test_scaffolds.applicability: when incident plans, incident records, exercises, and corrective actions are provided
test_scaffolds.limitations: Cannot establish that all incidents were captured or that personnel would respond effectively in an actual event.

test_scaffolds.title: Source change authorization and test traceability
test_scaffolds.applicability: Git repositories with locally exported pull-request, ticket, approval, and CI metadata where available
test_scaffolds.limitations: Git alone cannot prove approval or production deployment. Local exports may omit activity; auditor sampling and population-completeness procedures remain necessary.

test_scaffolds.title: Vendor inventory and review reconciliation
test_scaffolds.applicability: when vendor, contract, data-flow, and vendor-review records are locally available
test_scaffolds.limitations: Cannot verify third-party representations or determine whether vendor risk treatment is sufficient.

test_scaffolds.title: Operating-period evidence continuity
test_scaffolds.applicability: Type II readiness when a proposed examination period and recurring controls are defined
test_scaffolds.limitations: Evidence continuity is not an opinion on operating effectiveness. Only the service auditor sets procedures, selects samples, evaluates exceptions, and issues the SOC 2 Type II report.

test_scaffolds.title: System description readiness inventory
test_scaffolds.limitations: DC1-DC9 refer to AICPA Description Criteria rather than Trust Services Criteria. The tool does not determine whether the description is fairly presented.

test_scaffolds.title: Capacity and resilience configuration review
test_scaffolds.applicability: only when availability is in scope and local deployment configuration and capacity evidence exist
test_scaffolds.limitations: A configuration review cannot prove achieved uptime, environmental safeguards, production capacity, or historical operating effectiveness.

test_scaffolds.title: Backup restore exercise
test_scaffolds.applicability: only when availability is in scope and a disposable local test environment and approved backup are provided
test_scaffolds.limitations: A single local exercise does not prove production recovery objectives, environmental protections, or operation throughout the examination period.

test_scaffolds.title: Processing input-output integrity sample
test_scaffolds.applicability: only when processing integrity is in scope and expected behavior and safe local test data are defined
test_scaffolds.limitations: Tests only supplied scenarios in a local environment and do not establish completeness, accuracy, timeliness, authorization, or operation for the full transaction population.

test_scaffolds.title: Confidential-data lifecycle readiness
test_scaffolds.applicability: only when confidentiality is in scope and classification, storage, retention, and disposal evidence is available
test_scaffolds.limitations: Pattern scanning is incomplete and can produce false positives. It cannot prove all confidential information is identified or protected across production.

test_scaffolds.title: Privacy notice, collection, and consent consistency
test_scaffolds.applicability: only when privacy is in scope and a locally runnable user interface plus privacy documents are provided
test_scaffolds.limitations: Does not provide a legal opinion, verify all collection channels, or establish informed consent and operational compliance over time.

test_scaffolds.title: Privacy lifecycle and rights evidence
test_scaffolds.applicability: only when privacy is in scope and local rights-request, disclosure, retention, quality, complaint, and monitoring records are available
test_scaffolds.limitations: Record review cannot establish population completeness, legal compliance, or control effectiveness; qualified privacy and service-auditor review is required.

runtime_requirements.allowed_inputs: local files, local databases, local container services, and explicitly authorized local test endpoints
runtime_requirements.default_behavior: read-only; active tests require an authorized disposable local target
